{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Culroon Minstrel''''' was a [[Jesoni-class liner|''Jesoni''-class liner]] operating in the area of activity of [[Dharus]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]], circa [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zardra]], wanting to capture Dharus for a reward, boarded the ''Minstrel'' and hoped the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] would attack the ship. Although Dharus had intelligence about the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] provided by his contacts, he was unaware of the independent bounty hunter who looked like an Imperial aristocrat. Dharus attacked the ''Minstrel'', boarded it, and was captured by Zardra.
